{{Quote|From Tython, the children of the Je'daii spread out across the Tython system. Traveling toward the sun, they settled on Sunspot and Malterra, Nox, and arid Krev Coeur.|[[Ketu]]|<ref name="DotJ1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Malterra''' was a minor [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located within the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region. The small world experienced violent storms when it passed the planet [[Sunspot (Tython system)|Sunspot]] in its orbit, and it had an extremely hot climate. More than thirty-six thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the non&ndash;[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Tythan|settlers]] of the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] colonized Malterra. [[Time/Legends|Millennia]] later, [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations had been established on the planet.

==Description==
Malterra was a minor [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with no [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that was located within the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region,<ref name="DotJ0" /> at grid coordinates L-10.<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the small world was the second closest to its [[Star/Legends|sun]], [[Tythos]], of all the planetary bodies in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]], and it was near to the orbital path of [[Sunspot (Tython system)|Sunspot]], the first planet of the system. The two worlds rotated around their common star in opposite directions, however. [[Scientist/Legends|Scientists]] speculated that Malterra had originated in the Tython system, as opposed to Sunspot, which was thought to be a rogue [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] that had been captured by the [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational pull]] of Tythos. Malterra experienced violent storms when it passed Sunspot in its orbit, and the climate on the small planet was extremely hot.<ref name="DotJ0" />

==History==
When the non&ndash;[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Tythan|settlers]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]&mdash;<ref name="DotJ1" />the fifth planet of the system&mdash;<ref name="DotJ0" />[[Second migration|traveled]] to its neighboring worlds more than a [[Time/Legends|millennium]] after<ref name="DotJ1" /> the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[36,453 BBY]],<ref name="Into the Void" /> they colonized Malterra.<ref name="DotJ1" /> By [[25,793 BBY]],<ref name="CBR2">{{WebCite|url=https://www.cbr.com/nycc-exclusive-ostrander-and-duursema-unveil-star-wars-dawn-of-the-jedi|text=NYCC EXCLUSIVE: Ostrander and Duursema Unveil "Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi"|archivedate=20200817183352|author=Manning, Shaun|date=2011-10-13|quote=[&hellip;] the series really gets going with events just prior to the Force Wars, which began in 25,793 BBY.}}</ref> [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations had been established on the planet, which were made possible by the use of [[Environment suit/Legends|environment suits]].<ref name="DotJ0" /> In that year,<ref name="CBR2" /> [[Ketu]]&mdash;a [[Je'daii Temple Master|Temple Master]] of the mystic [[Je'daii Order]]&mdash;told the [[Padawan (Je'daii)|Padawan]] learners [[Harun]] and [[Resi]] the history of the Tython system, and mentioned the colonization of Malterra, amid other events.<ref name="DotJ1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Malterra was first pictured in the entry for Tython in [[The Holonet]] feature of the official website for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''&mdash;a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[BioWare]]. The planetoid was depicted in a schematic of the Tython system. Since its establishment in [[2008]], ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} website has gone through a number of changes, resulting in the removal of some of the features and images that were originally located there, including the aforementioned schematic. Malterra's name and additional information on it were provided in ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0]]'', a preview issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' series of [[Star Wars comic books|comic books]]. The issue was published on [[February 1]], [[2012]], and was written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Jan Duursema]]. The small world was also mentioned in the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|first]] issue of the series, which was published on [[February 15]] of the same year.
